summary: The defective workflow used actions/checkout without disabling credential persistence, then executed build tooling from freshly cloned third-party repositories in the same job. The repaired PR head sets persist-credentials to false before those builds, and the exact-head Reviewed Apple Tools Build completed successfully.
learning_objectives: Disable persisted checkout credentials before invoking third-party build or generation scripts in the same job.
Treat read-only repository permissions as blast-radius reduction, not as a substitute for removing credentials from the worktree.
Add controls proving that untrusted or externally sourced build steps cannot recover repository credentials from Git configuration.
rejection_reason: PR #159 governed council Defender rejected the proposed lesson; do not revive from the same evidence.
